scanner.permissionNeeded: The app needs the camera to scan QR codes. Nothing is recorded or saved.

scanner.noCamera: The camera could not start. Search the name below instead.

attendance.title: Mark attendance
attendance.scanIntro: Ask the student to open My QR in the app and hold it in front of the camera.
attendance.noMatch: No student found. Check the spelling, or register the student.
attendance.searchFailed: Could not search. Check your internet connection.
attendance.unknownBody: This is not a student's QR code for this class. Search the name instead.

errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the facilitator can mark attendance.
errors.notFound: This student is no longer in the records.
errors.alreadyMarked: Another phone marked this student at the same moment. Check the list and try again.

hereNow.title: Who is here now
hereNow.empty: Nobody is checked in right now.
hereNow.sinceEarlierDay: Since {{date}} {{time}}: not checked out that day
hereNow.confirmBody: Use this when the class closes. Each visit ends now; a visit left open from an earlier day ends at that day's closing time.

myQr.title: My QR card
myQr.howTo: Show this code to the coordinator when you arrive and again when you leave. They scan it to check you in and out.
myQr.keepPrivate: This code is only for you. Do not send a photo or screenshot of it to anyone.
myQr.savedCopy: No internet right now. This is the copy saved on your phone; it can still be scanned.
myQr.loadFailed: Could not load your QR card
myQr.noRecordBody: Your login is not connected to a student record. Please speak to a coordinator.

register.title: Register a student
register.intro: Takes about two minutes. Only the name and date of birth are required.
register.ageMinor: Age {{age}} — under 18, a parent's consent is needed
register.emailHint: The student's own email, if they will use the app. Their login is connected to this record.
register.areaHint: Only the area, e.g. Koti. Not the full address.
register.guardianIntro: Needed because the student is under 18.
register.idCheckedHint: Look at the parent's ID to confirm who they are. Do not write down the number.
register.photoConsent: The parent agrees to a photo of the student on the class record.
register.writtenConsent: The parent has filled in and signed the paper consent form, and I have kept it with the class records.
register.linked: Their app login is now connected to this record.
register.loadFailed: Could not load levels and coordinators.

errors.dobInvalid: Enter the date of birth as day-month-year, e.g. 15-06-2012.
errors.consentNeeded: The signed consent form is needed before a student under 18 can be registered.
errors.minorNeedsConsent: A student under 18 needs the parent's details, the ID check and the signed consent form.
errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the facilitator can register students.
errors.fixFields: Please correct the fields marked in red.

students.title: Students
students.loadFailed: Could not load the student list.
students.empty: No student matches. Change the search or the filters.

profile.title: Student profile
profile.notFound: This student is not in the records.
profile.guardianStaffOnly: Only coordinators and the facilitator can see this.
profile.consentMissing: No current consent from the parent is on record. Please tell the facilitator.
profile.noSyllabus: The syllabus for this level has not been added yet.

syllabus.title: Syllabus tick-off
syllabus.intro: Tap the box when the student shows the item in class. Today's date and your name are saved with the tick.
syllabus.remarkHint: Optional, e.g. "needs a steadier tempo". Up to {{max}} characters.
syllabus.untickBody: Use this only if it was ticked by mistake. The date and remark go from the list; the class records keep a copy.
syllabus.alreadyTicked: Someone else ticked this a moment ago. Their tick is kept.
syllabus.alreadyUnticked: This was already unticked. Nothing changed.

errors.remarkTooLong: The remark is too long. Keep it under 500 characters.
errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the facilitator can tick syllabus items.
errors.gone: This item or tick is no longer there. The list has been loaded again.
errors.retired: This item is no longer taught, so it cannot be ticked.

syllabus.allDone: Every item of {{level}} is ticked. Moving up a level is the facilitator's decision.

followUp.title: Follow-up calls
followUp.intro: Students who have stopped coming. Tap a name to phone them and record the call.
followUp.loadFailed: Could not load the follow-up list.
followUp.empty: Nobody needs a call right now.
followUp.escalatedHelp: Several calls with no answer, or no call made before the student became Inactive.

callLog.title: Log a call
callLog.noPhone: No phone number on the record.

outcomeHelp.returning: They will come again. If they have not come by the day after the date, a new call is due.
outcomeHelp.paused: They are taking a break until the date (exams, travel, health). No reminders till then.
outcomeHelp.not_reachable: Nobody answered. A new try is due in a few days; after several tries the facilitator is told.
outcomeHelp.discontinued: They have stopped coming. Their status becomes Left. They keep their roll number, and their next visit makes them Active again.

callLog.commentHint: Required. A short note for whoever calls next.
callLog.confirmLeftBody: They leave the follow-up list. Their record, roll number and history are kept.
callLog.confirmLeftYes: Yes, save and mark as Left

saved.returning: {{name}} is expected on {{date}}. If they do not come, a new call is due the day after.
saved.not_reachable: Saved as not reachable. A new try is on the follow-up list.

errors.dateInvalid: Enter the date as day-month-year, e.g. 15-10-2026.
errors.datePast: The date cannot be before today.
errors.commentRequired: Write what was said on the call.
errors.reasonUnknown: This reason is no longer in the list. Choose another.
errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the facilitator can log calls.
errors.notFound: This student is not in the records.

compose.title: New announcement
compose.titleHint: Short, e.g. "No class on Friday". Up to {{max}} characters.

audienceHelp.all: Every student who uses the app. Coordinators and the facilitator see every announcement.
audienceHelp.level: Students at the level you choose.
audienceHelp.mentees: The students you are mentor for.
audienceHelp.staff: Only the facilitator and coordinators. Students do not see it.
audienceHelp.group: The members of the group you choose.

compose.pin: Pin it to the top of the list
compose.laterHelp: Students see it from then. Coordinators and the facilitator see it at once.
compose.noGroups: There are no groups yet, so "A group" is not offered. Make one first.

detail.title: Announcement
detail.notFound: This announcement is no longer there.
detail.nobodyAddressed: Nobody with the app is in this audience yet.
detail.scheduledNote: Not published yet, so nobody has seen it.
detail.noLoginNote: {{number}} students in this audience do not use the app. Tell them in class.
detail.deleteBody: It disappears for everyone, with its photos and PDFs and the list of who has seen it. The class records keep a copy of the text.

edit.title: Edit announcement
edit.publishedNote: It stays read for those who have seen it, and shows "Edited" with the time. The time it was published cannot change.
edit.scheduledNote: Not published yet: you can still change when students see it.

replies.title: Replies ({{number}})
replies.privateNote: Replies are private: only the author and the facilitator see them. Answer in person or by phone.
replies.whoReads: Only {{name}} and the facilitator see your reply.
replies.whoReadsNoName: Only the author and the facilitator see your reply.

errors.titleTooLong: The title is too long. Keep it to 120 characters.
errors.bodyTooLong: The message is too long. Keep it to 4000 characters.
errors.dateInvalid: Enter the date as day-month-year, e.g. 04-10-2026.
errors.timeInvalid: Enter the time as hours:minutes, e.g. 18:30.
errors.timePast: This time has already passed. Choose a later time, or publish now.
errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the facilitator can post announcements.
errors.cannotChange: Not changed: only the author or the facilitator can change it, or it was deleted.
errors.groupGone: This group no longer exists. Choose another.
errors.alreadyPublished: It was published meanwhile, so its time can no longer change. Nothing was saved. Try again.
errors.replyTooLong: The reply is too long. Keep it to 1000 characters.
errors.replyGone: This announcement is no longer there, or no longer for you.

files.limits: Up to {{max}} files. Photos are made smaller before they are sent. A PDF can be up to 5 MB.
files.consentHint: Only add a photo that shows a student if their parent has given photo consent. Many students are under 18, and the law (DPDP) requires a parent's consent.
files.full: {{max}} files added, the most an announcement can have.
files.uploading: Sending the files… this can take a moment on a slow connection.
files.tooMany: An announcement can have at most 3 files. Remove one first.
files.tooBig: This file is bigger than 5 MB. Choose a smaller one.
files.notPdf: Only PDF files can be added here. For photos, use "Add photos".
files.someLeftOut: Only the first ones were added: an announcement can have at most 3 files.
files.pickFailed: The file could not be opened. Try again, or choose another one.
files.noPhotoAccess: The app may not open your photos. Allow it in the phone's settings.
files.wrongType: This kind of file cannot be added. Use a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or a PDF.
files.uploadFailed: The files could not be sent. Nothing was saved. Try again.
files.saveFailed: A file could not be saved with the announcement. Nothing was saved. Try again.
files.removeFailed: The files could not be removed, so nothing was deleted. Check your internet connection and try again.
files.title: Files ({{number}})

groups.title: Groups
groups.intro: An announcement sent to "A group" goes to its members. Members are students who use the app, coordinators and the facilitator.
groups.name: Name
groups.created: Group created. Now add its members.
groups.notFound: This group is no longer there.
groups.activeHelp: Offered when posting an announcement to "A group".
groups.offHelp: Not offered when posting. Old announcements keep this group, and its members still see them.
groups.noMembers: No members yet. Add people below.
groups.addHelp: Search for students who use the app, coordinators and the facilitator. Students without the app cannot be added.
groups.noMatch: Nobody found who is not in the group already.
groups.moreResults: {{number}} more. Type more of the name to narrow it down.

errors.nameTooLong: The name is too long. Keep it to 60 characters.
errors.purposeTooLong: This is too long. Keep it to 200 characters.
errors.nameTaken: Another group already has this name.
errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the facilitator can change groups.
errors.cannotChange: Not changed: the group is no longer there.

appUpdate.readyBody: Restart the app to use it. It takes a few seconds.
appUpdate.restartFailedTitle: The app could not restart by itself
appUpdate.restartFailedBody: Close the app fully (swipe it away) and open it again: the new version starts then. If you report this, send the line below too.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.body: This part of the app is being built. There is nothing here to tap yet.
comingSoon.instruments: The temple's mridangas: which ones there are, their condition, who has taken one home and when it comes back.
comingSoon.events: Festivals, yatras and programmes where the class plays, with the date and who is coming.

progress.title: My progress
progress.intro: The items you have shown in class are ticked by your coordinator. Moving up a level is the facilitator's decision.

syllabusEditor.title: Syllabus and lessons
syllabusEditor.introGuru: Enter each level's syllabus in teaching order, and add the lessons: YouTube videos, PDFs and photos. Ticks already given always stay.
syllabusEditor.introStaff: The syllabus of each level and its lessons. Only the facilitator changes them.
syllabusEditor.itemsHint: In teaching order. Tap an item to see its lessons.
syllabusEditor.itemsHintGuru: In teaching order. Move items up or down; tap an item to edit it, add lessons, or retire it.
syllabusEditor.retiredHint: No longer taught. Students who had them ticked keep their ticks. Put one back to teach it again.
syllabusEditor.itemNotFound: This item is no longer there.
syllabusEditor.newItemLine: {{level}} · it will be item {{position}}, at the end. You can move it afterwards.
syllabusEditor.titleHint: What the student learns, e.g. "Kaherva taal, slow". Up to {{max}} characters.
syllabusEditor.descriptionHint: What to show in class to have it ticked. Up to {{max}} characters.
syllabusEditor.ticksKept: Ticked for {{count}} students. Their ticks stay when you change the text.
syllabusEditor.retireHint: Retire an item that is no longer taught: it stays in the records of the students who have it ticked. Delete is only for a mistake nobody has ticked yet.
syllabusEditor.retireAskBody: It will not be taught or ticked any more and will not count in progress. The {{count}} ticks already given stay. You can put it back later.
syllabusEditor.deleteAskBody: Nobody has ticked it and no lesson points to it, so nothing else is lost. This cannot be undone.
syllabusEditor.cannotDelete: This item cannot be deleted because students have it ticked or lessons point to it. Retire it instead.

errors.titleTooLong: The title is too long (at most 120 characters).
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description is too long (at most 1000 characters).
errors.hasTicks: Students have this item ticked, so it cannot be deleted or moved to another level. Retire it instead.
errors.hasMaterials: Lessons point to this item. Remove them first, or retire the item.
errors.notAllowed: Only the facilitator can change the syllabus.

materials.openFailed: Could not open it. Check your internet connection and try again.
materials.levelHint: Videos, PDFs and photos that are not for one item.
materials.itemHint: Videos, PDFs and photos for this item. Students see them under the item in My progress.
materials.guruOnly: Only the facilitator adds and changes lessons.
materials.notFound: This lesson is no longer there.
materials.linkHint: In YouTube, tap Share and Copy link, then paste it here. Unlisted videos work.
materials.pickPdfHint: A PDF of up to 10 MB, e.g. notation.
materials.pickPhotoHint: A photo, e.g. a notation page. It is made smaller before it is sent.
materials.fileKept: File: {{name}} · {{size}}. To use another file, delete this lesson and add a new one.
materials.titleHint: What students see, e.g. "Kaherva taal, slow". Up to {{max}} characters.
materials.noteHint: A line under the title, e.g. "Practise with the metronome at 60".
materials.whereHint: Students see a lesson from its level upward. Choose an item, or the whole level.
materials.deleteAskBody: Students will no longer see it. A PDF or photo is deleted too; a YouTube video stays on YouTube.

errors.tooBig: This file is bigger than 10 MB. Choose a smaller one.
errors.titleTooLong: The title is too long (at most 120 characters).
errors.linkInvalid: This is not the link of a YouTube video. Copy it from YouTube's Share button.
errors.noteTooLong: The note is too long (at most 1000 characters).
errors.uploadFailed: The file could not be sent. Nothing was saved. Try again.
errors.gone: This lesson or its item is no longer there.
errors.removeFailed: The file could not be removed, so nothing was deleted. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.notAllowed: Only the facilitator can add and change lessons.

visitHistory.title: My attendance
visitHistory.intro: Every visit to the class, with the time in and out (India time).
visitHistory.noneRecently: No visits in the last {{months}} months.

myProfile.title: My profile
myProfile.phoneHint: For coordinators to reach you, e.g. +91 98765 43210.
myProfile.rollNameHint: The name on your roll card is kept by the coordinators. Ask one of them to correct it.

errors.nameTooLong: The name is too long (at most 80 characters).
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number of 7 to 20 digits; it may start with +.

assessments.title: Assessments
assessments.coordinatorIntro: Assessments the facilitator sent to the coordinators. Open one to release it to students and follow up.
assessments.emptyGuru: No assessments yet. Create the first one.
assessments.emptyCoordinator: No assessments from the facilitator yet.
assessments.emptyStudentBody: When a coordinator gives you one, it shows here.
assessments.notReleased: Not given to any student yet.

compose.title: Create assessment
compose.instructionsHint: What the student should play or sing, and how to record it.
compose.levelUpLabel: Level-up assessment: an accepted recording can be sent to the facilitator for promotion
compose.rubricHint: What is scored. Each line gets a score from 0 to its top score (1 to 10).
compose.filesHint: Up to {{max}}: a notation photo or PDF, a demonstration recording or video (at most 50 MB each).
compose.linkHint: For example an unlisted YouTube video. Starts with https://

detail.title: Assessment
detail.notFound: This assessment is not there, or it is not for you.
detail.draftNote: Draft: coordinators cannot see it yet
detail.sentDone: Sent. Coordinators can now release it to students.
detail.deleteNote: It has not been given to anyone. Its files are deleted too.

release.title: Give to students
release.notesHint: Shown to the students with the assessment.
release.dueInvalid: Write the date as day-month-year, for example 15-11-2026.
release.already: {{count}} already have it and are not shown.
release.search: Search by name or roll number

tracker.title: Students
tracker.hint: Tap a student to see their recording and review it.
tracker.noLogin: No app login: tell them in class

remind.all: Remind everyone who has not sent it ({{count}})
remind.skipped: Already reminded in the last 12 hours: {{count}}.

review.title: Review
review.scoreHint: A score for each line of the rubric.
review.scoresMissing: Give a score for every line.
review.commentHint: What went well and what to practise. Needed for a redo.
review.redoDone: Saved. The student is asked to record it again.
review.waitingRedo: A redo was asked for. Waiting for the new recording.

submit.title: Send your recording
submit.again: Record it again and send it
submit.hint: Record with your phone's recorder or camera, then choose the file (at most 50 MB), or paste a link.
submit.linkHint: For example an unlisted YouTube video or a Google Drive file. Starts with https://
submit.sent: Sent. Your coordinator will review it.

files.addGalleryVideo: Choose a video from the gallery
files.chooseRecording: Choose an audio or video file
files.notRecording: This is not an audio or video file the app can take (mp3, m4a, aac, wav, ogg, amr, mp4, mov, 3gp, webm, mkv).
files.tooBig: The file is larger than 50 MB. Record a shorter or smaller one, or send a link.
files.someLeftOut: Only the first ones were taken.
files.pickFailed: Could not open the file. Please try again.
files.uploadRefused: The file could not be saved. You can send at most 10 files a day, and only while an assessment waits for you.
files.removed: The file was deleted 30 days after the review.

errors.not_allowed: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.title_too_long: The title is at most 120 characters.
errors.instructions_too_long: The instructions are at most 4000 characters.
errors.rubric_required: Add at least one rubric line.
errors.rubric_invalid: Each rubric line needs a name (at most 80 characters) and a top score from 1 to 10; at most 8 lines.
errors.file_not_yours: Only files you uploaded yourself can be used.
errors.file_missing: The file did not finish uploading. Please try again.
errors.link_invalid: A link starts with https:// and has no spaces.
errors.already_sent: It was already sent to the coordinators.
errors.assessment_released: It has been given to students, so this cannot change.
errors.assessment_not_found: This assessment is not there, or not sent yet.
errors.due_past: The due date cannot be in the past.
errors.due_too_far: The due date is at most a year from today.
errors.notes_too_long: The notes are at most 2000 characters.
errors.nothing_to_assign: Every student you picked has it already.
errors.not_open: This is waiting for its review, or already done.
errors.recording_required: Choose a recording or paste a link.
errors.note_too_long: The note is at most 1000 characters.
errors.submission_not_found: This recording is not there any more.
errors.already_reviewed: Someone has already reviewed this recording.
errors.outcome_required: Choose Accept or Ask for a redo.
errors.scores_invalid: Give a score for every line, within its top score.
errors.comment_required: Write a comment so the student knows what to change.
errors.comment_too_long: The comment is at most 2000 characters.
errors.level_up_not_allowed: Only an accepted level-up assessment can be sent to the facilitator.

edit.title: Edit assessment
edit.lockedNote: It has been given to students, so the type, level, level-up and rubric stay as they are. The title, instructions, files and link can change.

promotion.answersLine: Answers: {{count}} of {{needed}} · Ready {{ready}} · Almost {{almost}} · Not yet {{notYet}}

criteria.syllabusAll: Syllabus of this level: {{done}} of {{total}} ticked (all needed)
criteria.syllabusPart: Syllabus of this level: {{done}} of {{total}} ticked ({{percent}}% needed)
criteria.visits: Visits in the last {{weeks}} weeks: {{count}} ({{needed}} needed)
criteria.levelUpMissing: No accepted level-up assessment of this level yet

panel.title: Promotion
panel.open: Nominated: waiting for the coordinators' feedback and the facilitator's decision.
panel.notYetUntil: The facilitator said "not yet". A new nomination is possible after {{date}}.

home.guruHint: Students nominated for the next level. Only you promote.
home.coordinatorHint: Nominate students who meet the criteria, and give feedback on others.

list.introGuru: A student moves up only when you approve, after the coordinators who teach them have given feedback.
list.introCoordinator: Nominate a student when they meet the criteria; give your feedback when other coordinators nominate. The facilitator decides.
list.collectingHint: Not enough coordinators have answered yet. You can still say "not yet" or ask for more feedback.
list.toAnswerHint: Open one to rate the student: Ready, Almost or Not yet.
list.toAnswerNone: No nomination waits for your feedback.
list.readyHint: They meet every criterion the facilitator set.
list.readyNone: No student meets every criterion right now.

nominate.title: Nominate for promotion
nominate.notAllMet: Not every criterion is met. You can still nominate; say why in the reason. The facilitator sees the check.
nominate.reasonHint: What the student plays well now, and anything the facilitator should know.
nominate.askHint: The coordinators picked get a notification. At least {{count}} coordinator answer(s) are needed before the facilitator can promote; your nomination counts as one "Ready".
nominate.noCoordinators: There are no other coordinators to ask.

detail.title: Promotion
detail.criteriaHint: From the settings the facilitator set.
detail.answersHint: Each coordinator who teaches the student: Ready, Almost or Not yet.

answer.title: Your feedback
answer.hint: How ready is the student for the next level?
answer.commentHint: What you saw in class: strong points and what still needs work.

decide.title: Your decision
decide.hint: The app never promotes by itself.
decide.needsAnswers: Promote is possible when {{count}} more coordinator(s) have answered.

noteLabel.more: What should the coordinators look at?

noteHint.not_yet: What to practise before the next nomination. The coordinators see it.
noteHint.more: The coordinators who have not answered get a notification.

decide.dateInvalid: Write the date as day-month-year, for example 15-11-2026.
decide.confirmBody: The student's level changes now and is written in the level history.

done.promote: Promoted. The student and the nominator are told.
done.more: Asked. The coordinators who have not answered are told.

withdraw.note: The answers stay on record. The student can be nominated again.

errors.not_allowed: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.student_not_found: This student is not there, or has left.
errors.top_level: The student is already at the highest level.
errors.too_soon: The facilitator said "not yet"; wait until after the date given.
errors.reason_too_long: The reason is at most 2000 characters.
errors.rating_invalid: Choose Ready, Almost or Not yet.
errors.comment_too_long: The comment is at most 1000 characters.
errors.feedback_needed: Not enough coordinators have answered yet.
errors.level_changed: The student's level has changed since the nomination.
errors.more_note_required: Write what the coordinators should look at.
errors.note_too_long: The text is at most 2000 characters.
errors.date_past: The date must be after today.
errors.date_too_far: The date is at most a year from today.
errors.level_guru_only: Only the facilitator changes a student's level.

practice.title: Practice tools
practice.staffHint: Metronome and taal player. Only students' practice time is logged.
practice.metronomeIntro: Beat 1 is accented. Set the tempo or tap it.
practice.taalIntro: Plays the bols of a taal in a loop. Slow it down to learn it.
practice.soundFailed: Sound could not start on this device. Check the volume and try again.
practice.savedTaals: No connection: showing the taals saved on this phone.
practice.noTaals: No taals yet. The facilitator adds them.
practice.twoHeadIntro: The drum as you see it when you play: baya (left hand) on the left, dayan (right hand) on the right. The ring that is struck lights up.
practice.tapHint: Tap 3 or 4 times in time; the tempo follows.
practice.timerIntro: Starts by itself when you press Start, or start it here. Stop it when you finish: 1 minute or more is saved in your practice log.
practice.timerTooShort: Less than a minute: not saved.
practice.timerForgotten: The timer ran for more than 6 hours, so it was not saved. Add your time in the practice log.
practice.panelIntroOwn: Your practice time, week by week (from Monday).
practice.panelIntroStaff: Practice the student logged, week by week (from Monday).
practice.unknownBol: "{{bol}}" is not a bol the app knows; it plays a plain stroke.
practice.ringsLegend: Rings from the rim inwards: kinar, maidan, syahi (the black centre).
practice.marksLegend: X sam · 2, 3 tali (an open baya stroke) · 0 khali

practiceLog.title: My practice log
practiceLog.addIntro: For practice without the timer: a day of the last week, 1-240 minutes.
practiceLog.empty: No practice logged in these weeks.
practiceLog.deleteHint: Entries of the last 14 days can be deleted.

errors.not_allowed: Only a student's practice is logged.
errors.started_invalid: The timer's time does not fit. Add the time by hand.
errors.date_invalid: Pick a day of the last 14 days.
errors.taal_not_found: That taal is no longer offered.
errors.note_too_long: The note is too long (200 characters at most).
errors.day_full: That day already has 12 hours of practice.
errors.too_many: Too many entries today. Try again tomorrow.

taals.title: Taals
taals.introGuru: The taals students play in Practice tools. Placeholder taals are stand-ins: replace them with the real ones.
taals.introStaff: Only the facilitator adds and changes taals.
taals.switchedOff: Switched off: students do not see it
taals.name: Name
taals.bolsHint: - for a rest; bols in one beat joined with a dot, e.g. dhā - te.re ka
taals.marksHint: One per vibhag: X sam (first), 2 or 3 tali, 0 khali
taals.deleteHint: Practice already logged with it keeps its minutes.

problems.bols: Each beat is - or up to 4 bols joined with a dot, without spaces.
problems.divisions: The vibhags must add up to the number of beats.
problems.marks: One mark per vibhag, the first X; the others 2-9 or 0.

errors.taal_divisions_invalid: The vibhags must add up to the number of beats.
errors.taal_marks_invalid: One mark per vibhag, the first X; the others 2-9 or 0.
errors.taal_bols_invalid: Each beat is - or up to 4 bols joined with a dot.
errors.taal_note_too_long: The note is too long (300 characters at most).
